title: Nzbhydra2 (LinuxServer.io)
description: Nzbhydra2 is a meta search application for Nzb indexers, the spiritual successor to Nzbmegasearch, and an evolution of the original application Nzbhydra. It provides easy access to a number of raw and newznab based indexers.
